trace.question: Which student has been entrusted to manage the budget for the Yearly Kickoff?
trace.evidence: name of students means the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name;'Yearly Kickoff' is an event name;

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = x.link_to_member
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = x.link_to_member
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
trace.answer: The budget for the Yearly Kickoff has been entrusted to two students: Sacha Harrison and Elijah Allen.
